questions.question: Leaders told Ezra that Israel's holy seed had been mixed with the people of the land. How did this happen?

answers.text: They married women from the local peoples
They traded in the local peoples' markets
They served in the local peoples' armies

questions.question: When Ezra heard the leaders' report about Israel's unfaithfulness, he tore his tunic and cloak. True or false?
In his prayer, Ezra said God had punished Israel more than their iniquities deserved. True or false?
In his prayer, Ezra asked what God might do if the people broke His commandments again. What did he ask?

answers.text: Wipe them out with no survivor
Send them back down to Egypt
Give their land over to Moab
